svg.title: Detector verdicts on every sensor trace
svg.desc: Acceleration magnitude for all 13 labelled sensor traces, replayed through the real FallDetector and ManDownDetector. 13 of 13 behave as labelled: the four falls and the collapse raise an alert; drops, sitting and walking do not.
svg.text: thresholds from DetectorConfig: free fall < 5 · impact > 22 m/s² · still 2 s · man-down after 10 s without movement
